title: TCF corner: Unit 1
subtitle: Exam-style questions with only Unit 1 words

steps.title: How the real test works
steps.body:
In the TCF Canada listening test you hear each recording once and you cannot go back. Each question has 4 answers and only one is correct.

A wrong answer and a blank answer both score zero. So never leave a question empty. If you are not sure, choose the answer that sounds most likely.

Here you practise with only the words from Unit 1. First 5 listening questions, then 5 reading questions.

steps.question: What is the speaker's name?
steps.explain: Je m'appelle Léa means my name is Léa.

steps.question: Which language does the speaker speak?
steps.explain: Je parle anglais means I speak English.

steps.question: Where does the speaker live?
steps.explain: J'habite à Montréal means I live in Montréal.

steps.question: Who would you say this to?
steps.explain: Salut is informal. Use it with friends and family only.

steps.question: Who is Canadian?
steps.explain: Il means he. Il est canadien means he is Canadian.
Prénom is the first name, so it is Sam.
Nom is the last name, so it is Diallo.

steps.promptFr: Salut ! Je suis Julie. J'habite à Toronto.
steps.explain: J'habite à Toronto means I live in Toronto.
Canadienne is the feminine form, so the writer is a woman.
